title: Blind + Revision — Binary Search, Graphs, DP, Greedy, Trees (Aug 12–17)
description: One-day-shifted week starting Wed Aug 12. Base stays 1 blind + 1 revision daily. Saturday is the timed checkpoint. Sunday fully off, so the Greedy + Linked List day moves to Mon Aug 17. Focus: binary search feasibility/peak reasoning, BFS shortest-path vs topological sort, DP order-matters transitions, greedy heap placement, and the Tree DFS return contract.

weeks.label: Week 11 — Blind + Revision (Shifted Start, Sunday Off)

days.label: Wed — Binary Search on Shape + Binary Search on Answer

newProblems.title: Find Peak Element
newProblems.notes: 35 min timed. Binary search without a sorted array: compare nums[mid] with nums[mid+1] and move toward the higher side. State the invariant before coding — a peak always exists inside [lo, hi].

revisionProblems.reason: Binary Search on Answer — light confidence check only (likely memorized). Do not code it blind-fast; instead say out loud what you minimize, what canEat(speed) is, and why it is monotonic. 15 min.

days.label: Thu — Graph BFS shortest path + Topological sort canary

newProblems.title: Word Ladder
newProblems.notes: 40 min timed. Implicit graph + BFS for shortest transformation length. Build neighbors via wildcard patterns, mark visited on enqueue (not dequeue), and count levels rather than tracking paths.

revisionProblems.reason: Graph cycle detection / topological sort canary. Trigger: prerequisites imply a directed graph; answer is 'no cycle'. Kahn's indegree queue or DFS with 3-state coloring. 20 min timed.

days.label: Fri — DP order-matters transition + 1D DP base

newProblems.title: Combination Sum IV
newProblems.notes: 35 min timed. Traps the combination-vs-permutation distinction: loop target outer, coins inner because order matters. Write dp[t] = ______ before coding, then explain why swapping the loops changes the answer.

revisionProblems.reason: 1D DP base canary, and the direct contrast to Combination Sum IV — same shape, but order does not matter. State both loop orders and why min-coins is order-independent. 20 min timed.

days.label: Sat — Timed checkpoint: Hashing + Tree DFS return contract

newProblems.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
newProblems.notes: 30 min strictly timed, no notes. Checkpoint problem. Trigger: O(n) means hashing, not sorting. Only start a run at a value whose predecessor is absent.

revisionProblems.reason: Tree DFS return-contract canary, still Yellow. Before coding write: dfs(node) returns the best one-sided gain upward, while the global max may use left + node + right. 25 min timed, no notes.

days.label: Mon — Greedy heap placement + Linked List canary

newProblems.title: Reorganize String
newProblems.notes: 35 min timed. Greedy + max-heap: always place the most frequent remaining character that is not the previous one. Check feasibility first — impossible when maxFreq > (n + 1) / 2.

revisionProblems.reason: Linked List canary — multi-step pointer discipline that Reverse Linked List II already exposed. Three phases: find middle, reverse second half, merge alternately. 20 min timed.
